m4_asher.boundary: The host had severe cumulative swap/pageout pressure and co-resident ComfyUI; fusion-disable samples were unstable and are inconclusive.

comparison.reason: Asher regressed and the lower-pressure Levi repeat reached parity with the existing production runtime, not an improvement. A later parent/exact-commit A/B isolated about 1.13% fusion benefit, but the exact fusion revision failed four raw-gates correctness cases and still did not exceed the measured production baseline.

feature_ablation_m4_levi.method: Same binary and model, three 128-token decode repetitions per condition; production launchd service stopped for the run and restored by trap.

interpretation.boundary: The grouped Metal fusion path is beneficial on M4; this ablation does not prove that the whole bdc23b56 candidate is faster than production.

exact_commit_ab_m4_levi.method: Parent, exact fusion revision with GGML_GDN_RAW_GATES_DISABLE=1, then parent; each run generated 128 tokens with three repetitions. Medians are primary because one sample in each of the first two runs was an observed low outlier.

correctness.raw_gates_disable_boundary: The environment switch avoids raw gates in the model graph, but the backend test explicitly exercises the raw-gates path and still fails four cases.

exact_commit_ab_m4_levi.decision: correctness rejected; do not admit the exact fusion revision

rebuild_reproducibility_m4_levi.boundary: The retained canary's passing raw-gates result did not reproduce from a fresh build of the same revision. The original build cache/configuration was not retained, so its binary hash and passing result remain evidence for that artifact only, not a reproducible source qualification.

deployment.server_build_boundary: The local server UI archive build stopped for insufficient disk after llama-bench and test-backend-ops had built successfully.
deployment.decision: retain versioned canary; keep the existing production runtime

boundaries: This is single-request 128-token decode, not fleet concurrency or aggregate-throughput qualification.
The final warm Levi control is used because its first two samples were unstable; all raw samples are retained.
Correctness passed on both Apple generations, but correctness alone does not authorize production admission.
DFlash2 remains an unselected option and was not changed by this experiment.
The graph fusions themselves improve M4 decode by about 1.1%; the rejected result is the candidate as a production unit, not the optimization idea.
A fresh bdc23b56 rebuild failed the same four raw-gates cases; the earlier 43/43 result is artifact-specific and not reproducible from the retained source revision alone.
The production Levi service was restored after each benchmark and returned status ok on 100.102.78.81:8094.
